name: Volume Guard
overview: Server leveling, dialogue boost, measured loudness and night profiles
description: Experimental audio processing for Jellyfin 12.2 and standard Moonfin. Includes leveling, peak limiting, dialogue emphasis, per-device modes, cached local-library loudness analysis and administrator playback status. Optional active switching requests a brief playback reconnect; Live TV returns to the live edge. No companion app required. Enable server processing in plugin settings. Physical client and Live TV validation remains necessary.

versions.changelog: Adds dialogue emphasis, whole-track local movie/episode loudness analysis with persistent cache, per-device mode/boost overrides, confirmed encoder status, and opt-in switching during playback via a brief reconnect. Movies resume at the reported position; Live TV returns to the live edge. Run Volume Guard loudness analysis in Scheduled Tasks after enabling analysis. New features default off/inherit. Automated checks pass; actual Chromecast/server/Live TV playback remains unverified.

Adds opt-in server audio processing for standard Moonfin: requests audio conversion at playback negotiation, applies leveling and peak limiting in FFmpeg, and keeps video copying available where compatible. Manual on/off, Balanced/Night/Auto and weekly schedules are in Jellyfin plugin settings. Restart playback after changes. No companion app or Moonfin preview-screen/player button is required. Validate on a real server and Chromecast before relying on it.

Initial experimental release: shared audio profiles, timezone-aware weekly night schedules, administrator configuration, and authenticated companion policy API. Install the Android TV companion separately for actual audio processing and player toggles. Physical Chromecast and Live TV playback validation remains necessary.
